tokenName: First National Bank SME Digital Token
underlyingAsset: Small & Medium Enterprise portfolio of First National Bank
description: Tokenised SME loan portfolio of First National Bank. Each token represents a fractional share of diversified SME credit facilities issued under Zambia SME development policy.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Banking Act; Central Bank SME Tokenisation Framework 2024

tokenName: First National Bank Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Warehouse receipt token issued by First National Bank against commodity stock deposited at certified warehouses in Zambia. Tradeable digital receipt on Algorand.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Warehouse Receipts Act; Central Bank Commodity Tokenisation Guidelines

tokenName: First National Bank Agriculture Finance Token
description: Digital token representing agricultural credit facilities provided by First National Bank to smallholder farmers and cooperatives in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Agriculture Finance Act; Central Bank Green Finance Policy 2024
